episodes.title: Dismantling Fitness Cults: Functional Patterns
episodes.description:
This video breaks down the claims of the controversial fitness company Functional Patterns. I give a brief history, assess the claims, and give an overall scientific defensibility rating based on the existing literature. I also talk about whether I think FP is helpful for combat athletes.
